message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by winning rounds and are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw** – If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends.
2. **Play** – Place one card from your hand onto the discard pile that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top card. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time.
3. **Action** – If you play an action card, the next player must follow its rule (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild Draw Four). | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play (in a 2‑player game, acts like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player declares the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player declares the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, you risk being challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so allows the next player to challenge you: if you’re caught, you must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Skip/Reverse = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can counter with the same type. | | **No Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played freely without the “no other playable card” restriction. | | **Custom Decks** | Uno has many themed decks (e.g., Disney, Marvel). Rules stay the same. | **Quick Tips** 1. Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. 2. Use action cards strategically to block opponents or force them to draw. 3. Remember to call “UNO” loudly and clearly! Enjoy playing Uno!
